note: Admin registrations that name no mounted site, so they land on Django's default admin.site -- which no urlconf in this repo routes. BURNED DOWN TO ZERO on 2026-08-31; this is now a floor, not a backlog. May only shrink. The scanner was proven to still fire before this was lowered: planting a bare @admin.register(BlueprintPack) took it from 0 to 1, and restoring the site= argument took it back to 0. The previous note said the answer was 'not derivable from the settings split' because governance, metadata and orchestration were 'in NEITHER SHARED_APPS nor TENANT_APPS'. That was a substring-matching error: those three are listed in SHARED_APPS by their AppConfig path (apps.governance.apps.GovernanceConfig), not by bare module name, so a `"apps.governance" in SHARED_APPS` test misses them. All five apps involved -- compliance, governance, metadata, orchestration, policies -- are in SHARED_APPS and none is in TENANT_APPS, which is what made the per-model decision derivable after all. Placement rule applied: a model with a concrete `school` column can go on the tenant site because TenantAdminSite.register wraps it in _TenantScopedQuerysetMixin (verified: all four tenant placements carry that mixin); a SHARED model with no school column would hit _TenantUnclassifiedFailClosedMixin and render a permanently empty screen, so those went platform-only; where an app already had a convention it was followed (all 12 explicitly registered compliance siblings use register_tenant_admin). All 21 resulting site-placements were rendered -- changelist and add -- and every one returned 200. RE-AUDIT 2026-09-01: the count stays 0, but the SCOPE it was measured over was too narrow to mean much. collect() globbed only apps/*/admin.py and apps/*/admin/*.py, so it never opened apps/finance/payment_admin.py (five bare registrations) or apps/portal/admin_kb.py (eight) -- the zero above was a zero over the wrong file set. The scanner now walks apps/**/*.py excluding tests and migrations, and was re-proven to fire under the wider net: planting a bare @admin.register(Transaction) in payment_admin.py -- a file the old globs never read -- took it 0 -> 1, and restoring the file took it back to 0. The five real findings this exposed were fixed rather than baselined: Transaction, RefundRequest, PaymentReconciliation and PaymentAuditLog now register on the tenant site (apps.finance is TENANT_APPS, so they are schema-isolated and need no scoping mixin) and apps/finance/admin.py imports the module so the registrations actually execute; the duplicate stale PaymentAdmin was removed because Payment already had a live ModelAdmin. All four render 200 on the changelist; PaymentAuditLog's add view returns PermissionDenied because has_add_permission is False by design for an append-only audit log.
